title: Glowing rocket ship
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Exhaust flame glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="10" ry="14" fill="#FF6B00" opacity="0.85"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="3" ry="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Side fins -->
  <polygon points="30,62 18,80 32,74" fill="#D94040"/>
  <polygon points="70,62 82,80 68,74" fill="#D94040"/>
  <!-- Fin highlights -->
  <polygon points="30,62 24,74 32,70" fill="#FF7070"/>
  <polygon points="70,62 76,74 68,70" fill="#FF7070"/>

  <!-- Rocket body -->
  <path d="M50,10 C62,22 66,42 66,62 L66,78 L34,78 L34,62 C34,42 38,22 50,10 Z" fill="#E8EAF0"/>
  <!-- Body shading on the right -->
  <path d="M50,10 C62,22 66,42 66,62 L66,78 L50,78 Z" fill="#B8BCC8"/>
  <!-- Nose cone -->
  <path d="M50,10 C58,18 60,30 60,34 L40,34 C40,30 42,18 50,10 Z" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
  <path d="M50,10 C58,18 60,30 60,34 L50,34 Z" fill="#CC3333"/>

  <!-- Window ring -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="44" r="9" fill="#3A7BD5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="44" r="7" fill="#7EC8FF"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="44" r="4.5" fill="#B8E8FF"/>
  <!-- Window glint -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="41" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Body stripe -->
  <rect x="34" y="60" width="32" height="5" fill="#FFB84D"/>
  <rect x="34" y="60" width="16" height="5" fill="#CC8F33"/>

  <!-- Nozzle -->
  <rect x="38" y="78" width="24" height="6" rx="2" fill="#8A8FA0"/>
  <rect x="38" y="78" width="12" height="6" rx="2" fill="#6A6F80"/>

  <!-- Stars / sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="24" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="52" r="1.2" fill="#FFE066"/>
</svg>
